prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: two-frame WALK animation sprite sheet on actual transparent RGBA.
Draw TWO full-body sprites of the exact same adult RESEARCH green-haired woman from the references, side by side in TWO isolated columns with wide transparent margins.
Both figures walk in the SAME direction: to the RIGHT edge, nose clearly points RIGHT in both, identical right three-quarter body orientation and same camera angle. First figure LEFT leg forward, right leg pushes from behind; second figure RIGHT leg forward, left leg pushes from behind. Opposite natural stride phases for ONE walking cycle, NOT opposite directions. Both independently drawn, no horizontal mirroring. Keep the satchel, side-part and costume on their physically consistent sides.
Adult researcher: mint green wavy bob, round black glasses, gold earrings, botanical beige long cardigan, dark teal short belted dress, semiopaque black tights, dark brown ankle boots, brown shoulder satchel. She carries one closed dark book under the same arm in both phases. Free arm swings in opposite phase. Preserve attractive adult proportions and face, no oversized head. Detailed crisp shaded pixel art with volume in folds. Same physical head size, same foot baseline and body scale across the two drawings.
All hair, hands, bag, cardigan edges and boots fully inside separate columns with generous padding. True transparent RGBA background, no gradient or floor or glow, no red/yellow/green matte outlines, no text or labels, no frames or dividing lines, no extra props, no watermark.
